INC-7310.note: Root cause: FastShip's v3 migration on Apr 14 cut our account-level label API limit from 300 to 100 requests/minute (buried in the v3 release notes). 4 workers x batch 100 already exceeded it; scaling to 8 workers and the fixed 1s retries made it worse. Fix: scaled carrier-sync back to 4 workers, set FASTSHIP_BATCH_SIZE=25 and FASTSHIP_MAX_RPM=90, switched retries to exponential backoff that honours the Retry-After header. Backlog drained by 13:10, error rate 0%. Follow-ups: request a quota increase from FastShip before peak season (JIRA-B-541), and the Carrier Integration Overview doc still says 300/min — needs updating.
